name: stress_journalists_exclusions

spec.objective: Coverage for a data-privacy report on Indian health apps
spec.ask: An interview for a story on the report

persona.description: Technology and health journalists in India covering privacy, excluding Times of India and Hindustan Times

sender.name: Test Researcher
sender.headline: Security researcher at a privacy lab
sender.summary: Audited 10 Indian health apps and found 8 sharing identifiers with third-party trackers.

prompt: we published a report showing 8 of 10 popular Indian health apps leak user data; find journalists in India who cover data privacy or health tech for an interview, but skip anyone at Times of India or Hindustan Times
